find: In the Eduqas Component 1 Shakespeare question, part (i) asks you to analyse a printed extract (20 marks: AO1+AO2), while part (ii) asks about a theme or character elsewhere in the play (20 marks: AO1+AO2+AO4). replace: Your Shakespeare question prints an extract and asks two things: part (i) on the extract, and part (ii) on the play as a whole. Together they are an extract question and a whole-play essay, 40 marks in total, and you have about an hour for both. Both parts reward the same skills: understanding of the play (AO1), analysis of language, structure and form (AO2), and accurate spelling, punctuation and grammar (AO4).
